inj.note: Per Hensley, on the bright side, Ioane's injury is not believed to be a long-term issue. As of Tuesday, he has not been placed on the Ravens' injured reserve list. It's still not clear exactly how many games he'll have to sit out, but in the meantime, 2025 third-rounder Emory Jones figures to take over as Baltimore's starting right guard.

news.h: Sources: Ravens rookie G Olaivavega Ioane expected to miss time with MCL sprain
news.d: Ravens rookie guard Olaivavega Ioane is expected to miss time after spraining his MCL in Sunday's loss to the Bengals, sources told NFL Network.
